prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Ink and Electric Yellow: page #181818, text #FAFAFA, accent #F4E84A, secondary surface #303030, text on accent #111111. Set headings in EB Garamond and reading text in Work Sans; literary serif heading with restrained sans text. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 20px, heading 80px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
